gui.simplemap.tooltip.mapping_mode:
Chunk-stream mapping completes loaded chunks by priority.
The legacy random DOTS pipeline has been removed.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.auto_clear_pin: Automatically remove the temporary navigation pin within 5 blocks of it.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.scan_slider:
Loaded chunk-column scan budget per client tick.
Higher values fill surface and cave layers faster but use more CPU.
AUTO uses the frame-time deadline and scans as fast as the client can safely sustain.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.rescan_loaded:
Continuously rescan loaded client chunks.
OFF (Default): Scans explored blocks once for max performance.
ON: Keeps re-scanning live loaded chunks to pick up world changes.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.scan_input:
Approximate 16x16 chunks processed per tick.
AUTO/MAX is recommended for modern systems.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.fast_fullscreen: Temporarily gives the open full map a larger bounded scan/upload budget.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.death_points: Create a local waypoint at the player's position on death.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.death_limit: Maximum retained death waypoints per dimension.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.restore_defaults:
Restore HUD, color, performance and waypoint preferences.
A confirmation screen appears first.
Waypoints, explored map data and block overrides are kept.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.reload_regions:
Re-color and reload all saved map regions in the background.
The current image stays visible until each replacement is ready.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.map_flowers: Draw small flower blocks on the map. Disabling can reduce visual noise.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.block_colors:
ACCURATE uses registered block and biome colours.
VANILLA uses Minecraft map colours.
gui.simplemap.tooltip.terrain_shading:
OFF is flat · 2D uses gentle relief.
3D uses stronger multi-direction slope shading.
